class: a pin git can neither resolve nor classify

expect.why: `git show HEAD@{99}:docs/note-100.md` answers nothing, so the pointer does not resolve
git exits 128 rather than answering, so the comparison did not happen; a comparison that did not happen is never a fresh ground

history: apply commits/01, commits/02, … as successive commits in a fresh repository; expectations name the commit they apply to. `@commitNN` in an entry is substituted with the real short object id of that commit before it is made, because a seed cannot know an id the runner has not created yet
note: a reflog pin in a repository with one commit is the cheapest way to make git decline to answer rather than answer no. The two reports are not one defect under two names: resolve says the pointer does not resolve, freshness says it could not be checked, and the second is the one that must never be silence
